image_prompt_prefix: Use the attached character sheet as the exact reference for the main character: a small chubby sea otter mascot with dark chocolate-brown fur, cream face, round black eyes, blush cheeks, a light sky-blue knitted scarf with a white wavy pattern, and a tiny yellow spiral notebook. scenes.title:
팩트체크 #1
번개 **두 번 안 쳐?**
narration: 번개는 같은 곳에 두 번 안 친다? 정말일까요?
scenes.image_prompt: S1 scene (hook): the otter looks up at a distant dark storm cloud with a small lightning bolt far away, tilting its head, holding the yellow notebook, a red question mark floating above its head. Calm, safe distance, cozy dusk colors.
scenes.motion: The otter slowly tilts its head and blinks; the red question mark bobs slightly; distant lightning glows softly once.

scenes.title:

scenes.image_prompt: S3 scene: the otter at a small wooden desk writing in the yellow notebook, a tall lightning rod on a little hill visible through the window behind it, with a distant storm cloud. No text.

scenes.image_prompt: S4 scene: the otter standing safely far away looking up at a single tall pointed tower standing alone on a hill under a stormy sky, with a bright lightning bolt hitting its tip. Otter is small in the foreground, clearly safe.
